**![](data:image/png;base64,)**
- Two terminals (A and B) of the trimpot are connected to two ends of a resistive strip.
- The centre terminal W is connected to a wiper which can be moved by turning the dial.
- It is a common practice to connect terminals W and B when connecting the device between A and W. In the event that the wiper breaks from the resistive strip, the bulb will still light dimly.
